title: Payroll Administrator
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company

A well-established and supportive education trust in East Cornwall is seeking an experienced Payroll Administrator to join its central team on a part-time basis. Supporting approximately 250 employees across multiple primary schools, the trust prides itself on delivering high-quality services and maintaining a collaborative working environment.

Your new role

As Payroll Administrator, you will take ownership of the end-to-end payroll process for the trust, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time each month. This is a standalone payroll position reporting directly to the CFO, with support available from the wider finance team.
Key duties will include:
- Processing monthly payroll for approximately 250 employees.
- Managing payroll changes including starters, leavers, contractual amendments and absences.
- Ensuring compliance with PAYE, National Insurance, pensions and payroll legislation.
- Responding to payroll queries from staff and management.
- Maintaining accurate payroll records and documentation.
- Producing payroll reports as required.
- Supporting audit and compliance requirements.
- Working to strict monthly deadlines and key payroll cut-off dates.

This role is offered on a rolling month-to-month basis, with an anticipated start date of 1st September.
What you'll need to succeedTo be successful in this role, you will have:
- Significant payroll administration experience.
- Strong knowledge of payroll legislation, taxation and compliance.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to manage your workload independently.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- Experience working to strict payroll deadlines.
- Confidence working in a standalone role.

Previous payroll experience within schools, academies or the education sector would be highly advantageous, although candidates from other sectors with strong payroll knowledge will also be considered.
Experience using EduPay would be beneficial; however, training can be provided for the right candidate.

What you'll get in return
- Flexible two-day-per-week working arrangement.
- Competitive hourly rate of £15-£20 per hour, depending on experience.
- Opportunity to join a supportive and collaborative education trust.
- Varied and autonomous role with responsibility for the payroll function.
- Flexible working days, subject to payroll deadlines.
- Immediate requirement with a September start available.

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Temporary Payroll Assistant - £14.00 - £15.00 per hour - Full or Part Time - Initial 3 Month Contract with Potential for Extension

An established business is seeking a Payroll Assistant to join its payroll team on a temporary basis. This role has been created to provide additional support during a particularly busy period and will focus on payroll administration, data entry, reconciliations, and supporting the accurate processing of monthly payrolls.

Working as part of an experienced payroll team, you will play a key role in ensuring payroll information is processed accurately and on time across multiple payrolls, while assisting with HMRC reporting and payroll administration duties.

Key Responsibilities

Processing and maintaining payroll records

Accurate input and validation of payroll data

Supporting the monthly processing of two payrolls covering approximately 700 employees across multiple entities

Processing new starters and leavers

Assisting with payroll reconciliations and balancing activities

Supporting HMRC submissions, RTI reporting and general payroll compliance

Assisting with statutory payments including SSP and other payroll-related calculations

Supporting pension administration and submissions

Working with time and attendance data to ensure payroll accuracy

Investigating and resolving payroll discrepancies

Responding to payroll-related queries from employees and managers

Providing general administrative support to the wider payroll function

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in a Payroll Assistant, Payroll Administrator, or similar payroll support role, together with a good understanding of payroll processes and administration. You will have excellent attention to detail, strong data entry skills, and be comfortable working with large volumes of information while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.

You should be organised, dependable, and capable of managing priorities within a deadline-driven environment. Knowledge of UK payroll legislation and HMRC requirements would be advantageous, as would experience using payroll software such as MorePay or time and attendance systems such as Kronos, although neither is essential.

Please apply ASAP to Elle Benjamin quoting reference EB11279.

title: Client Bookkeeper

Client Bookkeeper - Helston - £27,000 - £35,000

Have previous bookkeeping experience gained within an accountancy practice environment and be confident managing a varied workload across multiple clients.
